reason.message: The dzn behavioral gate exceeded its configured timeout before the inner gate returned a structured verdict.

nextSteps: Re-run with a narrower --filter or a larger VITRUM_BEHAVIORAL_GATE_DZN_TIMEOUT_MS when collecting full-tier evidence.
Use the lavapipe behavioral gate for lite-tier/API proof when full-tier validation is not required.
If the same narrow dzn lane repeatedly times out, treat it as a WSL/dzn validation-host issue until a browser/real-adapter run confirms otherwise.
